title: Canonical Premium Payment Event
description: Provider-independent payment state event. Contains no payer personal data, payment token, or raw provider payload.

schemaVersion.description: Major contract version. Incompatible changes require a new version.

eventId.description: Stable identifier for this provider state-change event.

paymentKey.description: Stable business identity, also used for Salesforce Payment_Key__c upsert.

providerEventId.description: Provider event ID, or deterministic ID derived from transaction state when none exists.

amountMinor.description: Original payment amount in currency minor units; CLP has exponent zero.

refundedAmountMinor.description: Refunded amount in minor units when supplied by provider; null otherwise.

occurredAt.description: Provider state-change timestamp normalized to UTC.

reasonCode.description: Sanitized provider failure or reversal reason; never include personal data.
